name: clovervet.pet.list
description: List household pets with allergies, handling flags, exam validity and caretaker delegations.

name: clovervet.pet.get
description: Fetch one pet profile including its vaccinations, lab panels and optional missing-asset warning.

name: clovervet.pet.update
description: Update mutable pet notes, weight_kg, handling_flags or authorized_caretakers.

name: clovervet.vaccination.list
description: List vaccination records and lab clearances for a pet or household.

name: clovervet.clearance.check
description: Evaluate boarding_stay or interstate_travel compliance against seeded clearance_rules and virtual_now without mutating state.

name: clovervet.clearance.list
description: List clearances with virtual-time-derived effective_status (including expired without mutating state).

name: clovervet.clearance.issue
description: Issue a boarding or interstate travel health clearance certificate when all seeded clinical prerequisites pass.

name: clovervet.clearance.revoke
description: Revoke an existing issued clearance certificate.

name: clovervet.slot.search
description: Search open clinic appointment slots by branch, vet, visit_type, fear_free_room or cat_only_slot.

name: clovervet.appointment.get
description: Fetch a single veterinary appointment and its revision history.

name: clovervet.appointment.book
description: Book an open clinic slot enforcing dental bloodwork prerequisites, fear-free/cat-only handling flags, caretaker delegation and conflict checks.

name: clovervet.appointment.reschedule
description: Reschedule a scheduled appointment to a new compatible open slot.

name: clovervet.appointment.cancel
description: Cancel a scheduled appointment, assessing late-cancel fee if within 24 hours unless penalty_free_until covers virtual_now.

name: clovervet.prescription.list
description: List active veterinary prescriptions and refill requests.

name: clovervet.prescription.get
description: Fetch a single prescription or refill request by ID.

name: clovervet.prescription.request_refill
description: Request a prescription refill enforcing heartworm-test validity, pet weight band, allergen conflict, remaining refills and duplicate active refill checks.

name: clovervet.prescription.amend_refill
description: Amend fulfillment_mode, pickup_branch_id, pickup_person_ref, shipping_address or notes on a requested or vet_review refill.

name: clovervet.prescription.cancel_refill
description: Cancel a pending requested or vet_review refill before fulfillment.
